Overview.Name: G John Newton
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Minimal non-veg, mostly vegetarian, avoids non-veg on Sunday

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + curd
Option 2: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + paneer cubes (80 g)
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & mushroom curry + vegetable fry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & curd
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & cooked vegetables
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 3: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid non-veg on Sunday and follow vegetarian options.
Improving sleep duration will help recovery, stress control and fat loss.
Keep meal timings fixed even on busy freelance work days.
Start meals with paneer, eggs or mushrooms before eating rice.
Regular badminton and consistent meals will improve energy and overall health.
